scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: I gcomhthéacs nuachta, tagraítear sé do thuarascáil nó aithris.
Úsáidtear é chun caint faoi théama nó fhadhb.
Comhoiriúnóir a thugann isteach dhá-réir.
Torthaí nó tionchar rud éigin.
Briathar a chiallaíonn méadú.
Comhghluaiseacht údarás atá ag stiúradh tíre.
A bhaineann leis an bpobal nó leis an rialtas (ní príobháideach).
Aibriomas a chiallaíonn dhéarfacht.
Cinneadh a dhéanamh.
Tugann sé sin i gceist friotal.
Comhoiriúnóir a thugann isteach dhá-réir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Ar bhaineann tú amach an tuarascáil faoi an bplean nua iompair phoiblí?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Sea, léigh mé é. Cé go n-abair an rialtas go gcabhróidh sé, tá an-chuid daoine in aghaidh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Ceapaim go bhfuil an príomhchúis bhróidis an chostas. D'fhéadfadh sé cáin a mhéadú, agus d'fhéadfadh sin tionbhá mhór a bheith air an gheilleagar.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Is dócha, ach deir siad go n-ábharfaidh sé níos mó post. Nílim cinnte cad a chinneoidh siad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Sea, ach má ghéaraíonn siad seirbhísí eile, beidh fadhb ann. D'fhéadfadh an pobal a bheith níos mó faoi bhrú ná a cheapann siad.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Fanfaidh muid agus feicim. Cé go bhfuilim i bhfad imní, tá súil agam go gcuirfidh siad rogha maith.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Sea, ní féidir linn ach súil a chur. Seiceálfaidh mé an nuacht arís amárach.

scenario: Negotiating a minor disagreement
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun comhoiriúnacht le tuairim nó moladh a fheiceáil.
Cuirtear ina dhiaidh an abairt chun tuairim a chur ina luí.
Chun tiontas a mholadh gan aon chomhoiriúnacht a thabhairt.
Tugann sé seo rogha ar an rud a luaadh cheana.
Smachtlann nó straitéis chun rud a dhéanamh.
Rud a athrú, é a dhéanamh difriúil.
Úsáidtear é chun tagairt a dhéanamh do théama nó fadhb.
Tugann sé seo síniú ar chinntíocht nó comhoiriúnacht.
Cosúil le 'maybe', ach níos foirmneach.
Tugann sé seo síniú ar easpa nó fáth rud.
Cuirtear sé seo chun smaoineamh a chur ina luí a dhéanann comhoiriúnacht leis an smaoineamh roimhe seo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I don't agree with your plan to go to the beach, though.
dialogue.translation: Níl mé sásta do phlean chun dul go dtí an trá, faraor.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we could change the time instead of changing the place.
dialogue.translation: B'fhéidir gur féidir linn an am a athrú i gcomhréir leis an áit a athrú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not sure it's the best matter to discuss right now.
dialogue.translation: Sin smaoineamh maith, ach níl mé cinntiúil go bhfuil sé seo an cúis is fearr le plé anois.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we should just decide together without arguing.
dialogue.translation: B'fhéidir go gcaithfimid cinneadh a dhéanamh le chéile gan aon argóint.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but I still think the plan has a problem, though.
dialogue.translation: Tá mé sásta, ach creidim fós go bhfuil fadhb ag an bplean, cé.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try a different plan, perhaps a picnic instead?
dialogue.translation: B'fhéidir gur féidir linn plean difriúil a thriail, b'fhéidir picníc i gcomhréir leis sin?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, that could work without any problem. Let's do that, though.
dialogue.translation: Cinntiúil, d'fhéadfadh sé sin oibriú gan aon fhadhb. Déanaimis sin, faraor.

scenario: Giving feedback on someone's work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun a léiriú nach ndearnadh rud éigin go dtí seo.
Léiríonn sé aighneas. Nóta: Tá 'though' ar an liosta a shealú, ach tugtar isteach air anseo mar eisceacht ar iarracht an chórais.
Tagraítear leis don leibhéal den chaighdeán atá ag rud éigin.
Athraíonn sé aidiachtáin nó briathra chun a neartú nó chun céim a shainmhíniú.
Déan rud éigin a bheith níos fearr.
Torthaí nó tionchar gníomhartha.
Úsáidtear é chun smaoineamh a chur chun tosaigh a dhéanann aighneas leis an smaoineamh roimhe seo.
Cuir fiúntas ar rud sula ndéanann tú cinneadh.
Is féidir é a dhéanamh nó a tharlú.
Tabhair nó soláthar rud éigin atá riachtanach.
Cabhrú nó tacú le duine nó rud éigin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I’ve read your draft, but I haven’t finished the last section yet.
dialogue.translation: Léigh mé do dréacht, ach níl an t-alt deireanach críochnaithe agam fós.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That’s okay. The quality of the beginning is quite good, I think.
dialogue.translation: Sin ceart go leor. Tá an cháilíocht ar dtús maith go leor, dar liom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree with that, though we need to improve the ending a lot.
dialogue.translation: Táim d’aontú leis sin, cé go gcaithfimid an deireadh a fheabhsú go mór.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, the result is not strong enough. However, your ideas are clear.
dialogue.translation: Sea, níl an toradh go leor daingean. Ar choinche, tá do smaointe soiléir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. What else should I consider for the final version?
dialogue.translation: Go raibh maith agat. Cad eile ba chóir dom a phlé don leagan deireanach?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It’s possible to add more examples, and provide more evidence for your claims.
dialogue.translation: Tá sé féideartha níos mó samplaí a chur leis, agus níos mó fianaise a thairiscint do do chuid gearán.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I’ll work on that. Can you support me with the data?
dialogue.translation: Iontrálach, oibríocht orm sin. An féidir leat tacaíocht a thabhairt dom leis na sonraí?

key_phrases.translation: Tá an cháilíocht maith go leor
Cad eile ba chóir dom a phlé?
An féidir leat tacaíocht a thabhairt dom le ...

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Dia dhuit, fuair mé mo chuid ordú inné, ach tá an dath mícheart.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Tá brón orm sin a chloisteáil. An féidir leat grianghraf den eirmhí a sheol chugam?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Go deimhin, seolfad é láithreach. Freisin, caithfidh mé an t-eirmhí a athsheoladh agus athíocaíocht a fháil.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Ar ndóigh. Ní ghlacfaidh muid táille asat as an athsheoladh. Seiceáil do ríomhphost le haghaidh treoracha, le do thoil.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Go raibh maith agat. Cé fada fanfaidh mé ag fanacht le haghaidh an athíocaíochta?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: De ghnáth, ghlacann sé 5–7 lá. Bí cúramach leis an lipéad athsheoladh a thugaimid duit, le do thoil.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Iontrálach, beidh mé cúramach. Go raibh maith agat as mo fhadb a réiteach.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é le haghaidh spriocanna nó cuspóirí, níos fórmála ná 'get'.
Tagraítear don tionscnamh oibre, ní 'cúrsa ollscoile'.
Tá sé san fhoghram roimhe seo, ach tá sé ar siúl arís sa liosta chun freastal ar an méid.
Is féidir é a úsáid chomh maith le 'conducir a'.

vocabulary.translation: leanúint ar aghaidh, leanúint ar siúl
a bheith ag déanamh, a bheith ag teacht

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Ba mhaith liom post ard a shárú i mo ghairm, ach is eol dom go mbeidh an-chuid iarratais ann.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. What kind of role would you like to reach in the future?
dialogue.translation: Is cuspóir iontach é sin. Cad é an dream parteachais a d'fheolfá go mba mhaith leat a bhaint amach sa todhchaí?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Ba mhaith liom fhoireann a stiúradh ar lá éigin, ach cheapaim go bhfuil gá agam le níos mó taithí ar dtús.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: B'fhéidir gur féidir leat deis a fháil chun tionscnamh beag a bhainistiú sa chuid oibre.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Sin é mo thuairim. Ní thagann rath ó oíche go hoíche, mar sin leanfaidh mé ar aghaidh ag staidéar agus ag fheabhsú mo scileanna.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude. I'm sure you'll achieve everything you set your mind to.
dialogue.translation: Sin an dearcadh ceart. Tá mé cinnte go ndéanfaidh tú sárú ar gach rud a chuireann tú do intinn air.

key_phrases.translation: ní thagann rath ó oíche go hoíche

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Tá sé seo ina dhéanamh go minic.
Tagraítear leis an gcorp fhisiciúil.
Is féidir é a úsáid mar ainmfhocal freisin, ach úsáidtear é mar bhriathráin anseo.
Stádas ginearálta folláine fhisiciúil agus intinne.
Fuinneamh chun rudaí a dhéanamh.
Gníomh an chodladh.
Séimh, nó rúin.
Cabhraíonn sé le do shláinte.
Tuasceart fhisiciúil nó intinne.
Ceanglaítear fáth le chéile.
Comparative de 'good' (maith).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Déanaim iarracht a bheith ag déanamh aclaíochta ar maidin, ach ní dhéanaim é go minic.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Tá sé ceart go leor. Is é an rud is tábhachtaí éist le do chorp agus rúin a fháil a oibríonn duit.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Is eol dom. Is fearr liom-sa nuair atá níos mó fuinnimh agam le linn an lae.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Sea, agus is cuid lárnach de sin an codladh. An ódhraidh tú seacht uair an chloig ar a laghad?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: De ghnáth, sea. Ach is é mo phríomh fhadhb an tuairt, ní an codladh.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Is féidir leis an tuairt do shláinte a bheith i bhfad níos measa. B'fhéidir gur gá duit séimh nua a fháil chun a bheith sásta, mar léamh nó siúl.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Is maith an smaoineamh é sin, mar is maith liom a bheith níos sláintiúla go ginearálta.

key_phrases.translation: a bheith níos sláintiúla go ginearálta

scenario: Describing a recent trip in detail
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun tagairt a dhéanamh do thrip iomlán, go háirithe de thuras pléisiúir nó gnó.
Briathar rialta; sa chaoi seo a deirtear 'arrived' sa bhliain.

vocabulary.translation: fanacht / a bheith i do thost
vocabulary.note: Is ainm atá ann freisin: 'a stay' = fanacht.
Comhcheanglaitheoir chun smaointe a choinneáil.
Cuirtear iallach isteach.
Tagraítear dó rud a fheiceáil ó áit.
Sinonim 'great' ach níos mó éifeachtach.
Úsáidtear é chun a chur in iúl, ach ní thagann sé chun 'very'.
Sa bhliain 'decided'.
Is féidir é a bheith ina chuntar nó ina aonad; anseo tagraítear dó taithí a bheith.
Is ainm atá ann freisin: 'taisteal' = taisteal i gcoitinne.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How was your trip to the mountains last weekend?
dialogue.translation: Conas a bhí do thrip go dtí na sléibhte an deireadh seachtaine seo caite?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It was quite wonderful, but we arrived later than we expected because of the traffic.
dialogue.translation: Bhí sé go leor iontach, ach tháinig muid níos déanaí ná mar a shupadaíomar mar gheall ar an tráffíc.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you stay in a hotel or in a cabin?
dialogue.translation: An bhfuil tú fanacht i gcóir nó i teachín?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We stayed in a small cabin with an amazing view of the lake.
dialogue.translation: Fanacht orainn i teachín beag le radharc iontach ar an loch.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the weather was cloudy, did you still enjoy the experience?
dialogue.translation: Cé go raibh an aimsir ghile, an bhfuil tú fós ag baint sult as an taithí?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we decided to go hiking, and we had a wonderful time, however, the trail was quite steep.
dialogue.translation: Sea, chinneadh orainn dul ag siúl, agus bhí ama iontach againn, ar choinníoll sin, bhí an bealach go leor dromchla.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm glad you had such a good time. I love to travel to new places too.
dialogue.translation: Tá áthas orm go raibh ama maith agat. Is breá liom taisteal go háiteanna nua freisin.

key_phrases.translation: tháinig muid níos déanaí ná mar a shupadaíomar

scenario: Talking about environmental issues
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun a rá go mbíonn tionchar, deighil go minic, ag rud amháin ar rud eile.
Focal chéad-ranga chun caint faoi laghdú tionchar na comhshaoil.
Tagraítear dó le haghaidh beart nó céim shonrach a thógann duine.
Ainmfhocal lárnach don téama seo. Úsáidtear leis an alt 'the'.
D’fhoghlaim tú go bhfuil sé ina shampla coitianta.
Úsáidtear é chun a rá go bhfuil rud amháin ann, mar shampla 'single-use' (úsáid amháin).
Tugann sé sin le fios go bhfuil sé leath-chinnte go dtarlóidh rud éigin.
Úsáidtear é chun fadhbanna móra nó tábhachtacha a dhréachtadh.
Tugann sé sin le fios go bhfuil sé fós ann. Is féidir é a úsáid chun 'fós' a rá.
Ar deireadh abairt, is maith é seo le rá 'ach'. Ar dtús abairt, is maith é seo le rá 'cé go'.
Úsáidtear é chun a rá go bhfuil duine i gcoinne rud éigin nó go bhfuil duine ag troid in éadan rud éigin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.
dialogue.translation: Ceapaim go bhfuil fadhb tromchúiseach i bhfábhrás plaisteach, ach úsáideann daoine fós i bhfad ró-mhór de.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Is eol dom. Earráid coitianta é bagaí plaisteach a úsáid do gach rud.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Go háirithe. Is féidir leis an gcóig sin damáiste mhór a dhéanamh don chomhshaol le breis ama.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: Mar sin, céard is fearr an beart is féidir linn a dhéanamh chun ár gcuid tionchar a laghdú?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.
dialogue.translation: Go maith, is céim shimplí é botailín a athúsáid a úsáid. Agus is dócha go gcoinneoidh sé mar chóig go tapaidh.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.
dialogue.translation: Sin ciallmhar. Nílim i gcoinne athruithe beaga, ach. Cabhraíonn gach rud beag.

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Briathráin neamhréigiúnach: choose, chose, chosen.
Ainmfhocal cuanta.
Sinonim do 'choice'.
I gcuntais chinneadh, ciallaíonn sé buntáistí agus mhíchuntais a mheas.
Tagraítear don toradh deiridh de chinneadh.
Féadfaidh sé bheith in ainmfhocal nó in briathráin.
Léiríonn sé cinnteacht nó rud sonrach ach gan sonraí a thabhairt.
Úsáidtear é chun an céim deiridh nó cinneadh a shainmhíniú.

vocabulary.translation: ní ba mhaith liom, i dtráthnóna
vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun toil a nochtadh.
Cuirtear iallach ann.
Léiríonn sé cúis.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Bhí orm rogha a dhéanamh idir dhá thairiscint post na seachtain seo caite.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Sin cinneadh deacair. Cé hiad na roghanna a d'fhan tú ag déanamh meas orm?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Chuir mé tús á bhaint leis an tsalar agus an téarma, ach bhí an riosca a bheith ag bogadh go cathair nua mar fachtóir mhór.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: An raibh tú cinnte faoi thorthaí gach rogha?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Ní hiondúil, cé go raibh a fhios agam go raibh an t-airgead níos airde sa dara post.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Mar sin, céard a chinneadh tú ar deireadh?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Roghnaigh mé an chéad phost, i dtráthnóna an dara, mar gheall ar an téarma níos giorra agus eileagar níos fearr idir saol agus saol.

scenario: Explaining why you changed your mind
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é le 'mind' chun athrú tuairim a chríochnú.
I 'change your mind' ciallaíonn sé athrú tuairim.
Úsáidtear é chun an t-am nuair a athraíonn tú d'intinn a mhíniú.
Úsáidtear é chun eolas oibjectach a chur isteach.
Is féidir é a úsáid go litreach nó go fiúrachta.
Tagraítear dó chun intinn nó tionscnamh.
Chríochnaíonn sé féidearthacht.
Úsáidtear é chun a choimeád le conas a bhí tú ag smaoineamh roimhe seo.
Mar chomhcheangail ciallaíonn sé 'mar'.
Tugann sé rogha eile.
Ag deireadh an abairt ciallaíonn sé 'fiú'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Chuir mé mo thiontú ar athrú maidir leis an aistear go dtí an trá an deireadh seachtaine seo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: I ndáiríre? Cén fáth? Bhí tú ag faire go hiontach faoi cheist roimhe seo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Go leor, bhí mé ar an eolas go raibh an réamhaisnéis aimsire dona, agus i ndáiríre, tá mé ag déanamh an-chuid oibre.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Ach bhí plean agat chun a bheith sásta agus a bheith ag baint sult as an ghrian!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Sea, ach bhí mé ar an eolas nach bhfuil sé féideartha dom mo thionscadal a chríochnú má théann mé. Mar is é an sprioc-am Dé Luain, caithfidh mé fanacht sa bhaile.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Sin factoir. Ach d'fhéadfá obair ar maidin agus dul níos déanaí, i dtráth a bheith ag cealú gach rud.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Sin smaoineamh maith, cé go gcaithfidh mé a fheiceáil an féidir mo chairde tacaíocht a thabhairt dom i dtaobh an turais. Go raibh maith agat as an comhairle!

key_phrases.translation: a bheith ar an eolas go

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Tagraíonn sé seo do chustaimí, smaointe agus traidisiúin grúpa.
Cleactas traidisiúnta áite.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Tá sé suimiúil dom conas atá a lán difríochtaí cultúrtha idir tíortha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Sea, fiú rud éigin cosúil le socrú is féidir é a bheith mar chustaim a athraíonn aireacht daoine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Mar shampla, i mo chultúr, is neamhchóir é ithe le do lámha, ach i gcúpla áit is ciallmhar é go hiomlán.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: De ghnáth, beartaim ar dhaoine na custaimí áitiúla a leanúint, ach déanaim iarracht meas a thabhairt ar na difríochtaí.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Sin maith. Cheapaim go bhfuil custaimí go leor cosúil i ndán, ach go ndéantar iad a fhorbairt go difriúil.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Mar sin, is é an eochair a bheith oscailte agus foghlaim faoi na difríochtaí atá againn.

key_phrases.translation: meas a thabhairt ar na difríochtaí

scenario: Discussing technology in daily life
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáid le haghaidh ceangail ríomhaire nó daoine.
Gléas eilektrónach cosúil le teilifís nó tábla.
An t-ardán ar a dtaispeántar íomhá.
Clár a shuiteáiltear ar an móbáil.
Fhoilsiú nó tabhair rochtain ar rud éigin.
Ceangailte leis an idirlíon.
Fuentas fuinnimh do ghlaonna.
Téacs nó cumarsáid gearr.
Tug sonraí ón idirlíon chuig an ngláseog.
Duine a úsáideann rud éigin, go háirithe teicneolaíocht.
Éasca a dhéanamh nó a thuiscint.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Caithim mo ghuthán nua a cheangail leis an Wi-Fi, ach ní féidir liom na socruithe a aimsiú.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Tá sé simplí. Téigh go dtí an aplicáid socruithe agus cuardaigh an rogha Wi-Fi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Ó, tuigim. Ach ba mhaith liom aplicáid teachtaireachta nua a íoslódáil chun teachtaireachtaí a sheoladh chuig mo chairde.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Sin úsáideach, ach seiceáil an batara ar dtús. Is féidir le íoslódáil a lán fuinnimh a úsáid.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Tá tú ceart. Agus cad faoi an scáileán? Fanann sé ar siúl ró-fhada uaireanta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Is féidir leat sin a athrú sna socruithe freisin. Mar sin féin, mar úsáideoir, ba cheart duit do suíomh a roinnt le do chairde amháin más maith leat iad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Go raibh maith agat! Tá mé sásta anois ag úsáid mo ghláiseog ar líne.

scenario: At a formal meeting giving your opinion
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

Úsáidtear é chun smaoineamh nó gníomh a thairiscint de mhaígh foirfe.

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun a rá go bhfuil smaoineamh déanta maidir le rud sula ndéantar cinneadh.
Comhoiriúnaí a thugann contrásta isteach i gcéim foirfe.
Comhoiriúnaí a thugann dul chun cinn loighiciúil isteach.
Foirfe agus oideachais chun is dócha a nochtadh.
Úsáidtear é chun foinsí nó sonraí a thagairt.
Comhoiriúnaí chun eolas a chur leis i gcéim.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: De mo thuairim, is é an príomh-fhadhb an buiséad don tionscadal.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Tuigim do phonte, ach cheapaim gur cheart dúinn an t-amchláir a bheith i gceist ar dtús.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: Sin pointe bailí. Mar sin, b'fhéidir gur féidir linn an dá rud a phlé le chéile.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Tá mé sásta leis sin. I gcostas, d'fhéadfaimis iarracht a dhéanamh ar níos mó sonraí ón fhoireann.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Smaoineamh maith. De réir an tuairisce is déanaí, tá roinnt saoirse againn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Ansín, molaim go ullmhófaímid tairiscint le dhá rogha.

key_phrases.translation: De réir an tuairisce is déanaí

scenario: Describing a person's character in depth

Duine a thugann gan choinne.
In ann fanacht gan a bheith goidte.
Mothaíonn sé nervúil nó neamhchomhordaigh le daoine nach bhfuil aithne aige orthu.
Déanann sé dea-obair do dhaoine eile.
Éasca le aithne a chur air agus tá sé toilteanach.
Úsáidtear i 'sense of humor' (ciall chomhartha).
Stádas éadrom sealadach.
Go minic.
Cuirtear ina leith uirthi cúis nó fáth.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I really admire my sister because she is always honest, even when it's difficult.
dialogue.translation: Tá mé i mo dhúshlán maith faoi mo dheartháir ina ionraic í i gcónaí, fiú nuair is deacair é.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's great. My best friend is very brave – he once stood up to a bully at school.
dialogue.translation: Sin iontach. Tá mo chairde is fearr an-mhisniúil – sheas sé in aghaidh fulaing i scoil uair amháin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, that takes courage. My sister is also generous and often helps our neighbors with their groceries.
dialogue.translation: Wow, is féidir sin a dhéanamh. Tá mo dheartháir daor freisin agus cabhraíonn sí lenár gcomharsana go minic le a dtionscail.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She sounds kind. My friend is usually patient, but he can get into a bad mood if he's tired.
dialogue.translation: Fuaimeann sí go cúramach. Is ciallmhar mo chairde de ghnáth, ach is féidir a bheith i mbun meabhair mhilis má tá sé tinn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My sister is a bit shy at first, but once you know her, she's very friendly.
dialogue.translation: Tá mé ag feiceáil. Tá mo dheartháir croíúil ar dtús, ach nuair a aithneann tú í, tá sí an-charaidh.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's nice. My friend has a great sense of humor – he always makes me laugh.
dialogue.translation: Sin go hálainn. Tá ciall chomhartha maith ag mo chairde – déanann sé mé a chur chun gáire i gcónaí.

scenario: Talking about education and learning
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun eolas nó scila a fháil.
Gníomh a dhícheall rudaí a fhoghlaim.
Duine a mhúineann.
Duine atá ag foghlaim.
Sraith leachtaí faoi ábhar ar leith.
Cás a léiríonn rialtas nó smaoineamh.
Abairt a iarrann eolas.
Tabhair freagra ar cheist.
Tuiscint a fháil ar chiall rud.
Rud a choimeád i gcuimhne.
A dhéanamh go leitheadach chun scila a fheabhsú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Caithim níos mó a dhéanamh ar mo chúrsa Béarla, ach níl achan ama agam.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Cén fáth nach dtéann tú i dteagmháil liom gach oíche? Is féidir linn foghlaim le chéile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Sin smaoineamh maith, ach tá ceist agam: an smaoineann tú go dtabharfadh ár múinteoir cabhair dúinn mura tuigimid rud éigin?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Ar ndóigh, freastalaíonn ár múinteoir i gcónaí gach ceist le sampla soiléir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Tá súil agam go gcuimhníos ar na focail nua go léir a fhoghlaimimid.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Má dhéanaimse cleachtadh gach lá, feiceann tú go gcuimhneoidh tú níos éasca.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Tá tú ceart. Tosaíonn muid inniu, agus is fearr liom a bheith mar mhac léinn!

key_phrases.translation: Caithim níos mó a dhéanamh ar mo chúrsa

key_phrases.phrase: Why don't you practice with me?
key_phrases.translation: Cén fáth nach dtéann tú i dteagmháil liom?

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é le 'problem'.
Úsáidtear go minic é le 'find' nó 'offer'.
Cé go bhfuil sé cheana féin sa liosta seo, cuirtear isteach anseo é le matáin difriúil: 'agree on' (aontú ar).
Sa chomhthéacs seo is ciall 'deacair' atá air, ní 'crua'.
Úsáidtear é chun moltaí a dhéanamh ar bhealach cúthail.
Tá sé ina shíniú ar thorthaíocht nó seicheamh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Tá fadhb mhór againn leis an gclár don seachtain seo chugainn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Tá a fhios agam go bhfuil sé deacair, ach b'fhéidir gur féidir linn réiteach a fháil le chéile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Ba mhaith liom mo thairiscint a thabhairt: d'fhéadfaimis an chruinniú a thabhairt go dtí an Aoine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Is éasca sin a dhéanamh, ach an mbeidh gach duine sásta leis an am nua?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Glaochfaimid orthu i dtosach báire, agus ansin is féidir linn cinneadh a dhéanamh faoi na rudaí atá le déanamh.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Plean maith. Déanaimis sin agus réiteoidh muid an fhadhb seo inniu.

scenario: Comparing two options for a trip
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun cinneadh a dhéanamh idir roghanna.
Briathar neamhrialtas: cost, cost, cost.
Tagraítear don am, ní don luíochán fhisiciúil.
Úsáidtear é chun rud a thabhairt leat.
Comparative de beag.
Úsáidtear é i gcomparáidí.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Ní féidir liom cinneadh a dhéanamh ar an rogha is fearr dár dturas: an bus nó an traen.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Go bhfuil, tá an bus níos saoire ná an traen, ach tá sé níos mall.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Sea, ach costann an traen níos mó, agus caithfimid teacht go luath.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Freisin, tá an traen níos sábháilte, go háirithe san oíche.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Ach tá an traen níos daoire, agus is féidir linn níos mó bagáiste a thabhairt ar an bus.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Sin fíor. Mar sin, b'fhéidir gur cheart dúinn an bus a thógáil agus níos lú airgid a chaillte.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Ceart go leor, imigh le chéile ar an bus. Is féidir linn airgead a shábháil agus spraoi a bheith againn fós.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How often do you usually post on social media?
dialogue.translation: Cé chomh minic a fhoilsíonn tú ar líne de ghnáth?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: Déanaim iarracht rud éigin a roinnt gach lá, ach uaireanta imím tríd mo feed gan aon rud a fhoilsiú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?
dialogue.translation: An leanann tú go leor daoine?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.
dialogue.translation: Tá, ach leanann mé mo chairde agus mo theaghlach go hinphríoch. Ní maith liom go bhfaighim ró-mheasc 'maith liom' nó tuairiscí, mar sin choinním mo phróifíl príobháideach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.
dialogue.translation: Sin é an smaoineamh. Tá próifíl poiblí agam toisc gur mhaith liom go mbacfaí mo fhoilsiúcháin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.
dialogue.translation: Tuigim. Ach is féidir le bheith ar líne an t-am ar fad a bheith tírigh, mar sin sriantaím mo chuid ama.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Maybe I should do that too.
dialogue.translation: Tá tú ceart. B'fhéidir gur chóir dom é sin a dhéanamh freisin.

key_phrases.translation: bheith ar líne an t-am ar fad

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun páirteanna de rud a lua.
Dírítear ar an rud is tábhachtaí.
I láithreáin, is é 'príomhphoint' an príomh-aidiomh.
Úsáidtear é chun dul chuig an chéad chuid eile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Ceart go leor, tar éis tús. Beidh trí phríomhchuid i mo láithreán.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: Fuaimionn sé go maith. Cad is é do chéad phoint?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Tá an chéad chuid faoi ár gcuid torthaí díolacháin ón mhí seo caite.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: Agus cad a chloísteáilfidh tú a continuación?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: A continuación, labhróidh mé faoi ár gpríomhduibheanna i rith an tréimhse sin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: An luáfaidh tú an straitéis mhargaíochta nua freisin?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Sea, sin pointe tábhachtach, agus críochnóidh mé le ár gcuid cuspóirí don mhí seo.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Sa chomhaireamh seo ciallaíonn sé leanúint spóirt nó foireann, ní ar na meáin shóisialta.

Chaith: cailleadh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: An bhfuil aon spórt agat leanúint? Táim go mór le haghaidh sacair.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Tá, déanaim amharc ar cispheil. Is iad na Lakers mo fhoireann is fearr, cé go bhfuil bua acu gach cluiche.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: D'imigh siad in aghaidh na Celtic an oíche sin, an bhfuil sé ceart? Cé a shcoir an méid is mó pointe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Tá, ach chaill muid. Bhí cluiche iontach ag a gceann is fearr.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Sin brón. An smaoiníonn tú go bhfuil deis acu sa chluiche iomaithe i rith an tséasúir seo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: B'fhéidir, ach tá sé deacair. Cé go bhfuil imreoirí maith acu, caithfidh siad a gcosaint a fheabhsú.
